market_context.rationale_en: The market shows a sustained downtrend over 20+ days (KOSPI −13.99%, KOSDAQ −13.11%) with high volatility (60-day annualized 52%+). Today's −1~−3% adjustment is a continuation of this downtrend, and holding 033780 shows clear weakness signals with continuous foreign/institutional selling. Policy signals (possible November rate hike) remain in review stage and are not yet confirmed, making them weak signals. Following the technical-first principle, it is appropriate to reduce new buy exposure for the next trading day while maintaining relative strength positions like 251970 and monitoring 033780.
